item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Define the CsvStat command architecture and module boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        go.md
provides:     csvstat architecture
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Go module layout, command boundary, internal package responsibilities, standard-library-only constraint, and error/output contracts for CsvStat.
  Keep application logic separate from process exit handling and preserve all supplied sources as read-only test assets.

## story cli-foundation
summary:      Build the csvstat command entry point and module.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-FOUNDATION.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:       st-003
depends:      architecture
stack:        go.md
provides:     ./cmd/csvstat, csvstat help
consumes:     csvstat architecture
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create the Go module and ./cmd/csvstat executable using only the standard library.
  Implement the documented invocation surface and useful help text for profile and frequency forms.
  Keep process exit handling in main and expose testable command behavior internally.

## story cli-input
summary:      Read, normalize, and structurally validate CSV input.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-INPUT.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:       st-007
depends:      cli-foundation
stack:        go.md
context:      sources/employees.csv, sources/sensors.csv, sources/orders.csv, sources/header_only.csv, sources/ragged.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/employees.csv: asset
  sources/sensors.csv: asset
  sources/orders.csv: asset
  sources/header_only.csv: asset
  sources/ragged.csv: asset
provides:     RFC 4180 CSV parsing, trimmed records, structural validation
consumes:     ./cmd/csvstat
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement CSV loading with encoding/csv.
  Trim headers and values before downstream processing, preserve quoted fields, reject empty files, invalid headers, and ragged records, and retain rejected-record line information for diagnostics.
  Do not read or embed answers from the supplied grader.

## story cli-columns
summary:      Resolve named columns and classify null values.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-COLUMNS.md
covers:       CLI-003
depends:      cli-input
stack:        go.md
provides:     column lookup, null normalization
consumes:     RFC 4180 CSV parsing, trimmed records, structural validation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement recognition of empty, NA, N/A, and NULL values case-insensitively after trimming.
  Resolve --column and --freq names against the validated header and reject absent names without producing stdout.
  Preserve the command's usage-versus-rejected-input exit-code distinction.

## story profile-types
summary:      Infer each column type using the specified precedence.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-PROFILE-TYPES.md
covers:       PROFILE-001
accepts:       st-004
depends:      cli-columns
stack:        go.md
provides:     integer, number, date, boolean, text, and empty inference
consumes:     column lookup, null normalization
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Infer each column from non-null values in the required order: integer, number, date, boolean, then text.
  Validate integer and number lexical forms, validate real calendar dates, handle case-insensitive booleans, and classify all-null columns as empty.

## story profile-statistics
summary:      Compute exact profile statistics and decimal formatting.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-PROFILE-STATISTICS.md
covers:       PROFILE-002
accepts:       st-005
depends:      profile-types
stack:        go.md
provides:     rows, nulls, distinct, extrema, sum, mean, median
consumes:     inferred column types, normalized records
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Compute every required profile statistic from the normalized records.
  Use exact arithmetic, including exact decimal sums, means, and medians, and round once half away from zero to exactly two decimal places.
  Apply type-specific extrema and leave nonnumeric statistic fields empty.

## story profile-output
summary:      Render profile results as CSV.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-PROFILE-OUTPUT.md
covers:       PROFILE-003
depends:      profile-statistics
stack:        go.md
provides:     profile CSV output
consumes:     rows, nulls, distinct, extrema, sum, mean, median
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Emit the exact profile header and rows in source-column order, or only the requested named column.
  Use encoding/csv so commas, quotes, and newlines are RFC-compliant, and emit empty fields as empty CSV fields.

## story frequency-values
summary:      Aggregate and order frequent non-null column values.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-FREQUENCY-VALUES.md
covers:       FREQ-001
accepts:       st-006
depends:      cli-columns
stack:        go.md
provides:     frequency aggregation and deterministic ordering
consumes:     column lookup, null normalization
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Count distinct non-null values for the requested column.
  Sort by descending count and then bytewise ascending value, excluding all null spellings and preserving exact normalized values.

## story frequency-limits
summary:      Validate and apply frequency row limits.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-FREQUENCY-LIMITS.md
covers:       FREQ-002
depends:      frequency-values
stack:        go.md
provides:     --top validation and frequency CSV output
consumes:     frequency aggregation and deterministic ordering
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement --top with default five and positive-integer validation.
  Reject --top without --freq, limit output after ordering, and render the value,count CSV header and rows.

## story cli-errors
summary:      Map operational, usage, and rejected-input failures.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-ERRORS.md
covers:       CLI-004
accepts:       st-007, st-008
depends:      cli-columns, profile-output, frequency-limits
stack:        go.md
provides:     exit-code and diagnostic contract
consumes:     CSV validation, column lookup, profile output, frequency output
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Centralize command validation and error mapping.
  Return 1 for file open/read failures, 2 for malformed arguments, and 3 for rejected input.
  Write no stdout on failure and write one diagnostic line to stderr naming the file and rejected record line when applicable.

## story test-gate
summary:      Provide the Go vet and test project gate.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TEST-GATE.md
covers:       TEST-001
accepts:       st-002
depends:      cli-foundation
stack:        common.md, go.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
consumes:     Go module and command packages
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Add a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that runs go vet ./... and go test ./... from the application root.
  Ensure it exits zero only when both commands succeed and add focused Go tests for the implemented behavior.

## story full-verification
summary:      Run the complete supplied CsvStat conformance suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-FULL-VERIFICATION.md
accepts:       st-001
depends:      architecture, cli-foundation, cli-input, cli-columns, profile-types, profile-statistics, profile-output, frequency-values, frequency-limits, cli-errors, test-gate
stack:        common.md, go.md
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/employees.csv, sources/sensors.csv, sources/orders.csv, sources/header_only.csv, sources/ragged.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: stage
  sources/employees.csv: stage
  sources/sensors.csv: stage
  sources/orders.csv: stage
  sources/header_only.csv: stage
  sources/ragged.csv: stage
provides:     full CsvStat conformance verification
consumes:     bin/test.sh, ./cmd/csvstat, complete CsvStat implementation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assemble the completed CLI and execute the supplied sources/run.sh without filtering, modification, or reinterpretation.
  Treat its exit status as the release verification result and preserve the supplied sources byte-for-byte.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
